text:
Maria G: heads-up — sa-east1 queue depth for orca-mini-30b just spiked, current backlog ~18k requests (x3 baseline). p95 gen latency > 3s, some SLOs breached.
Alex K: any change in traffic patterns? ingress from partner-batch?
Maria G: not obvious, p95 traffic rate up ~2.8x for the last 12m. metrics: 
```
> model: orca-mini-30b
> region: sa-east1
> inflight: 4200
> queued: 18400
> avg_latency_p95: 3.2s
> admission_drop_rate: 1.2%
> capacity_util: 98%
```
CJ: admission-controller is already soft-throttling, but we hit hard cap on continuous batching windows. we can tighten per-model qps cap or disable long-tail batching for orca to reduce KV pressure.
Devin: fallback routing to instruct-lite-3b would shave tokens and keep latency, but quality drop for some customers. which customers are affected?
Maria G: mostly self-serve dev accounts + a few low-tier tenants from LATAM partner. 2 enterprise tenants show slight error uptick but not critical.
Lucy: spinning up 2 extra g4dn-equivalent nodes in sa-east1 is possible but costy and slow (~8-12m). we also have spare quota in us-east1; cross-region routing could help but adds latency and egress cost.
Alex K: quick mitigation plan: 1) tighten orca-mini-30b admission qps by 25% for non-enterprise tenants (soft cap), 2) add rule to redirect <=2-token prompts to instruct-lite-3b for low-priority tag, 3) enable short-circuit KV cache TTL refresh to reduce memory pressure.
CJ: I can push the admission change. command: 
```
POST https://infra-admin.local/configs/admission
{ "model":"orca-mini-30b", "region":"sa-east1", "qps_cap": 0.75 }
```
Maria G: ops-bot created INC-5869 for the incident. tagging oncall.
ops-bot: INCIDENT INC-5869 created by Maria G — sa-east1 model backlog surge. Severity: P2. Linked runbook: /runbooks/queue-backlog.md
Devin: I'll draft a fallback mapping and a short eval harness to verify instr-light behaves for the common prompt classes (owner: Devin, ETA: 30m).
Lucy: I'll request a 2-node burst to sa-east1 (spot) as a safety net, but prefer routing first. cost estimate: ~ $1.4k/day if we keep burst up.
Alex K: CJ, can you roll the qps change now and monitor throughput + drops? Watch for cascading failures from client retries.
CJ: rolling now for non-enterprise tag. will publish change and watch.
Maria G: once qps cap is live, also flip on fallback route (Devin) and post quick stats. if backlog doesn't drop in 10m, approve Lucy's burst.
Devin: fallback route pushed to canary (10% traffic). sample results: 10% traffic -> queued down 14%, p95 down 0.4s for orca.
ops-bot: Alert: queue_depth_sa-east1_orca-mini-30b crossed 15k threshold -> auto-escalation window started.
Alex K: nice, keep canary at 10% for 15m, then increase if stable. CJ keep an eye on admission_drop_rate.
CJ: admission qps reduced, admission_drop_rate ticked to 2.9% (expected), queued dropping slowly.
Maria G: action items: 
- CJ: monitor + be ready to revert (ETA: ongoing)
- Devin: expand fallback to 30% canary after 15m if no regressions (ETA: 15m)
- Lucy: stand by for burst approval (ETA: 12m)
- Alex: coordinate comms to partner-batch if we escalate (ETA: 20m)
Everyone: reactions pls. :thumbsup: :eyes:
